reviews.title: Quality business motherboard
reviews.comment: Great value, easy setup.  I love the included software, and this motherboard is an essential piece of a great business pc with room for future upgrades and modernizations.
reviews.author: Emmett

reviews.title: Very Stable and Reliable Board
reviews.comment: Very stable board that works well.  Supports 13th and 14th Gen CPUs.  Not as many features and some of Asus other MATX boards but its been stable.
reviews.author: ABM

reviews.title: Hot garbage
reviews.comment: Absolutely the worst motherboard when it comes to setup. All sorts of issues.
reviews.author: tyler slayton

reviews.title: Good value for the price
reviews.comment: I had issues with the CPU being damaged while using this mobo, but the same issue happened again with a different motherboard, so looks like the mobo wasn't to blame.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer
